_comment: Proposed per-kind review bounds for qualification metrics, pending cos d1344. A move needs review when |candidate - previous| exceeds max(relative * |previous|, absolute). Units follow the metric report: gbp (pounds), count (people or units), rate and share (fractions, so 0.005 is half a percentage point). They are review triggers, not acceptance criteria: a move inside the bounds is still in the evidence.

receipt.why: 2% or £0.5bn: the Budget scorecard reports measures to £0.1bn, and model fixes moving a head by more than 2% should be explained.

caseload.why: 3% or 50,000 claimants: caseloads are calibrated targets; larger moves signal data or eligibility changes.

population.why: Population totals should barely move between pairs.

poverty.why: Half a percentage point on a rate.

decile.why: Half a point on a decile share.

double_count.why: Any change in a counted-once check needs review.

reform.why: 5% or £0.1bn on a reference reform costing.

reform_target.why: 5% or £0.1bn on a standard reform's change in its target variable.
